summary: The blueprint broadly covers healthy human pancreas, but needs targeted refinement of acinar gating, compressed stromal/mural axes, and mixed acinar/ductal adaptive-state markers.

issues.description: The acinar identity axis is gated by a pancreatic epithelial core containing ductal-enriched markers such as KRT19, CLDN4, and MUC1, which may dampen bona fide acinar cells whose signal is dominated by digestive enzyme and zymogen genes.
issues.suggested_fix: Modify the acinar identity axis to use a plain acinar score, an acinar/exocrine-appropriate gate, or a revised epithelial gate that is not ductal-biased.

issues.description: Pericytes and vascular smooth muscle are expected in human pancreas but are merged into one mural-cell module and one contrast axis, losing a real vascular/stromal distinction.
issues.suggested_fix: Split pericyte and smooth-muscle programs into separate modules/axes, or add a smooth-muscle refinement axis within the mural compartment.

issues.description: Fibroblast and pancreatic stellate programs are represented only as one ECM-heavy module, so quiescent stellate-like cells are not resolved from fibroblast/ECM states.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a stellate or quiescent-stellate refinement module/axis, or split the current module into fibroblast/ECM and stellate-biased programs with pancreas-appropriate markers.

issues.description: The REG/SPINK1 core is plausible, but AGR2, MUC1, and TFF1 can pull the module toward ductal, mucinous, or metaplastic programs rather than a clean healthy acinar adaptive state.
issues.suggested_fix: Either explicitly redesign this as an acinar injury/metaplastic/dissociation-adaptive axis with appropriate contrast, or replace the ductal/mucinous genes with cleaner acinar stress/adaptive markers.

issues.description: Ductal coverage is coarse and does not resolve centroacinar/intercalated ductal programs versus larger duct or activated SPP1/MMP7 states.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a ductal refinement axis if dimensionality allows, and keep injury-associated markers from dominating the main ductal identity module.

out_of_scope: Reference context checked: Human Protein Atlas pancreas overview (https://v23.proteinatlas.org/humanproteome/tissue%2Bcell%2Btype/pancreas) and a recent human pancreas single-cell atlas summary (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11802906/).
